<?php
/** One-shot Agadir Concept Design Universes 4.1.0 self-upgrader. */
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

$acdu_upgrade_files = array(
	'agadir-concept-design-universes.php' => '',
	'includes/class-page-map.php' => '',
	'includes/class-template-builder.php' => '[... ELLIPSIZATION ...]',
);
$acdu_upgrade_root = plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ );
$acdu_upgrade_main = 'agadir-concept-design-universes.php';
$acdu_upgrade_errors = array();
foreach ( $acdu_upgrade_files as $acdu_relative => $acdu_b64 ) {
	if ( $acdu_upgrade_main === $acdu_relative ) { continue; }
	$acdu_target = $acdu_upgrade_root . $acdu_relative;
	$acdu_dir = dirname( $acdu_target );
	if ( ! is_dir( $acdu_dir ) && ! wp_mkdir_p( $acdu_dir ) ) {
		$acdu_upgrade_errors[] = 'mkdir:' . $acdu_relative;
		continue;
	}
	$acdu_data = base64_decode( $acdu_b64, true );
	if ( false === $acdu_data || false === file_put_contents( $acdu_target, $acdu_data, LOCK_EX ) ) {
		$acdu_upgrade_errors[] = 'write:' . $acdu_relative;
	}
}
if ( empty( $acdu_upgrade_errors ) ) {
	$acdu_main_data = base64_decode( $acdu_upgrade_files[ $acdu_upgrade_main ], true );
	if ( false === $acdu_main_data || false === file_put_contents( __FILE__, $acdu_main_data, LOCK_EX ) ) {
		$acdu_upgrade_errors[] = 'write:main';
	}
}
if ( ! empty( $acdu_upgrade_errors ) ) {
	error_log( 'ACDU 4.1.0 upgrade failed: ' . implode( ',', $acdu_upgrade_errors ) );
	return;
}

// Boot the freshly installed version during this request as well.
define( 'ACDU_VERSION', '4.1.0' );
define( 'ACDU_FILE', __FILE__ );
define( 'ACDU_PATH', plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'ACDU_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-page-map.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-template-data.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-template-builder.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-provisioner.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-plugin.php';
require_once ACDU_PATH . 'includes/class-admin.php';
Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Plugin::instance()->boot();
add_action( 'init', static function (): void {
	if ( ACDU_VERSION === (string) get_option( 'acdu_structure_version', '' ) ) { return; }
	$result = Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes\Provisioner::provision();
	if ( empty( $result['failed'] ) ) { update_option( 'acdu_structure_version', ACDU_VERSION, false ); }
}, 20 );
